name: Izel Kuzey
source:
What kind of heroine would not want a Duke of the North as beautiful and mysterious as his name? 
Yet Duke Izel is far more eccentric than most male leads tend to be.... Especially given his commitment to hiding in bushes, worrying about sofas, and making ominous plans.
